definitions.gloss: moving out; vacating (a residence or property)
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving and giving up occupancy of a rented apartment, house, or other property.
The act of leaving or being made to leave a place, often due to danger or official orders.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{末|まつ}にアパートを{退去|たいきょ}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I'm planning to move out of the apartment at the end of next month.

examples.japanese: {退去|たいきょ}{時|じ}には{原状回復|げんじょうかいふく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Restoring the property to its original condition is required when moving out.

examples.japanese: {火災|かさい}のため{建物|たてもの}から{退去|たいきょ}を{命|めい}じられた。
examples.english: We were ordered to evacuate the building due to a fire.

notes:
FORMATION:
{退|たい} (withdraw, retreat) + {去|きょ} (leave, depart)

Sense 1 (rental context):
Common in real estate and rental agreements:
・{退去|たいきょ}{届|とどけ} - Notice to vacate
・{退去|たいきょ}{日|び} - Move-out date
・{退去|たいきょ}{費用|ひよう} - Move-out costs
・{原状回復|げんじょうかいふく} - Restoring original condition (often required)

Sense 2 (evacuation):
・{強制|きょうせい}{退去|たいきょ} - Forced evacuation/deportation
・{退去|たいきょ}{命令|めいれい} - Evacuation order

ANTONYM:
・{入居|にゅうきょ} - Moving in (to a residence)
